source: Internet Archive djen-tjro-2025 OCR cadernos (public DJEN publications)
labeler: prompt_subagents:haiku (one labeling subagent per batch, acordaos first)
notes: Seed gold built the subagent way: strict sampling (acordao requires ACORDAO+VOTO+ACORDAM, sentenca requires SENTENCA+dispositivo-formula+operative-verb; despachos excluded), Haiku labeling subagents returning {category,match,nth}, offsets resolved by opf_annotate from-spans, overlaps removed deterministically, then a decorrelated 4-role Sonnet ensemble over val+test. ref_normativa was originally excluded (regex pre-pass at inference) but was added back to the trained label space and bootstrapped into every split via the same regex pre-pass (scripts/ref_normativa_prepass.py) against the already-verified gold text -- see git history for the architecture decision and the regex fix (thousands-separator article numbers, spelled-out inciso/paragrafo/alinea) that preceded it. Single-tribunal (TJRO) seed of 20 docs; scale to more tribunals/volume next.
